visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable views, including the retained 1024×640 summary. The retained stepped compound has an open courtyard with pointed arcades, pale stone columns, a covered polygonal fountain and real entrance passage; pale walls with rectangular ground glazing, pointed upper fields and coarse red/cream bands; domed gallery roofs, lower side wings/cupolas, a gray ribbed central dome with paired semi-domes and two widely separated minarets with open balconies and conical caps. Semi-dome support walls and upper root closures were added; concave-envelope cornice triangles were replaced by per-edge strips; separate minaret plinths reach sampled grade; corner piers reach the hall roof. Fine inscriptions, exact ornament, neighboring library/bazaar/tombs, landscape, fence, furniture and interiors are omitted. The seated terrain fixture and court paving are illustrative finished levels.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views, including the placement overlay. Six existing 256² graphs serve raw/coursed/weathered limestone, brick, standing-seam metal and cast bronze; seven merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints, no embedded images or unique atlas. Each graph is read once and eviction disposes the model geometry. The five occupied ground masks include both notched ring pieces, both minaret bases and the fountain; the court stays open elsewhere. An initially omitted first mask was corrected. Precise building subtraction uses the filled current compound envelope joined to its two tower bases; the associated dome and fountain are replaced with them. All 43 independent neighbors remain. The overlay establishes approximate pose/replacement, not surveyed terrain contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. The central/paired semi-domes, open court, separated minarets and low wings remain legible. Skyline simplifies the court to broad openings, keeps three coarse gallery cupolas, coarse domes, minaret balconies/cones, entrance passage and a small dark fountain canopy; its fountain columns are merged away at distance. District restores the four-bay arcade rhythm, stone columns, facade fields, more cupolas and simple open balcony posts. Street adds recessed glazing, coarse grids, red/cream bands, fuller capitals, dome ribs and more facets. Closeup further refines curves/ribs and finials. Whole cameras retain the compound and both towers; detail cameras crop other portions. Synthetic context apartments and coarse terrain are illustrative. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city timing remains unmeasured.
